name: comp-184
title: Pill Switch With Icons
blurb: Pill-shaped switch with animating moon/sun icons.
description: Animated pill-style switch with sliding moon and sun icons that appear and disappear based on state.
use_when: Premium theme switcher in navigation or headers where smooth icon animation enhances perception.
avoid_when: When animation may distract or when accessibility tools struggle with complex transforms.
a11y: Built on accessible Switch primitive with sr-only label and aria-hidden on animating icons.
